### Minor updates specification v1.0.0 to v1.0.2

The modifications outlined below are deemed minor, as the XLUM format is not widely adopted; 
they are necessary to mature the format. After, any substantial revisions 
will necessitate a major version increment. 

* Remove `'camera'` and `'spectrometer'` from the specification as `recordType`, this did not make sense;
update XSD scheme accordingly. 
* Update Fig. 3.1 to align figure better with specification
* `xValues` and `yValues` allow double instead of signed integer values (specification and XSD schema)
* Change `NA` to `0` for `xValues` and `yValues`
* Correct type mismatch to align specification with XSD schema
* Typo correction and minor clarifications
